title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 20 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 20 - Imposition of Taxes on differences in Imports, Exports or  Investments Where it appears from the return filed by a taxpayer in any income year that the taxpayer— (a) there is a discrepancy between the actual    any import or export and the amount of money paid or received for the import or export declared by the taxpayer, or (b) there is a discrepancy between the amount actually invested and the amount declared by the taxpayer to have been invested, In that case, without prejudice to other provisions of this Act, tax shall be payable at the rate of 50% (fifty percent) on the difference mentioned in clause (a) or, as the case may be, on the difference between the amount of money actually invested and the amount of money declared as mentioned in clause (b).
